sections.section: RULES - Punjab Provincial Management Service Rules 2004
sections.description:
PUNJAB PROVINCIAL MANAGEMENT
PUNJAB PROVINCIAL MANAGEMENT
SERVICE RULES, 2004
(Amendment of Sched.I)
[Gazette of Punjab, Part I,
6th February, 2013]
No.SOR-III(S&GAD)1-16/2006,
dated 12-1-2013.---In exercise of the powers conferred under section 23 of the
Punjab Civil Servants Act, 1974 (VIII of 1974), Governor of the Punjab is
pleased to direct that in the Punjab Provincial Management Service Rules, 2004,
the following amendment shall be made:
In the said rules, in
Schedule I, against the
post of PMS
(BS-17), in Column No.7, at Sr. No.2(a), the words "and have passed
the prescribed departmental examination" shall be omitted.
